  SELECT 
    i.availability_zone,
    i.host,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS instance_count
  FROM instances i
  INNER JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.deleted = 0
    AND ic.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY i.availability_zone, i.host
),
avg_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count

)

  pc.instance_count AS count_for_flare3_blaze8_12,
  pc.instance_count - ac.avg_instance_count AS deviation_from_average
FROM pair_counts pc
CROSS JOIN avg_counts ac
WHERE pc.availability_zone = 'flare3'
